title: The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, Muhammad bin Rashid and Muhammad bin Zayed are witnessing the Al -Ittihad march
description: http://fw.to/mcxaots  04 December, 2016 - Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman Bin Abdul -Oziz Al Saud of Kingdom of Saudi arabia, Along with Vice President and Prime Minister of the Uae and Ruler of Dubai His Highness Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum and Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and DePuty SuPreme Commanner of the Uae Armed Forces His Highness Sheikh Mohamed Bin Zayed Al Zayed Al Zayed Al Zayed Al Zayed Al Zayed Al Zayed Al Zayed Al Zayed Al Zayed Al Zayed Al Zayed Al Nahyan Attended the Union Procession on Sunday afternoon. The procese is part of uae 45th National Day Center  http://fw.to/wk4l9yl  December 04, 2016 - The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, the King of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, "may God bless him" and His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and Deputy Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, "The March of the Union" that started this afternoon, within the activities of the Sheikh Zayed Heritage Festival for the year 2016 The forty -fifth of the state.

asr.full_text: The Shahid of the Holy Houses of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Salman bin Abdulaziz al-Saud, witnessed the events of the Sheikh Zayed Heritage Festival of 2016. His name is Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid al-Maktoum, Deputy Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Dubai. His name is Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al-Nihyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi, Deputy Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, and the President of the UAE. His name is Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al Ahnan, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Humanitarian Affairs. His name is Hamid bin Zayed Al Ahnan, Chairman of the House of the Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi. His name is Sheikh Omar bin Zayed Al Ahnan, Deputy Chairman of the Security Council of the Zayed bin Sultan Al Ahnan Foundation for Charitable and Humanitarian Affairs. His name is Khalid bin Zayed Al Ahnan, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Zayed Al Ahliya Foundation for Humanitarian Care and People with Special Needs. The participants expressed their popular and cultural humour. They exhibited from the platform amid national cheers. They waved the flag of the United Arab Emirates. The march reflected diversity, multiculturalism and the native Arab people. The participants expressed admiration and interaction with the people of the region. They expressed their love and respect for the country and their leadership. They also expressed their appreciation for the authentic Arab customs and traditions inherited from their fathers and ancestors. The UAE. is led by His Highness Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan. The head of state. Proud of its sons and faithful men. Who always show their dedication and loyalty. In service to the country and its elevation. He stressed that the UAE. integrates its heritage, traditions and traditions. With a future vision of the country. In balance achieves development, excellence and creativity. In all fields. He maintains the identity and origin of the UAE and its faithful people. The celebration began with a different performance. The poet cast a poem entitled "The Great Land Host" (Guardian of the Holy Prophet Muhammad) and "The Great Land Host") (Guardian of the Holy Prophet Muhammad) " (S.A.W.) and welcomed the great land host, the Hajj of the Holy Prophet (S.A.W.) and the great journey of the Union. The ceremony ended with the art of the Hajj. Music. Music. Allah Hobb is the life of Imam ibn Imam Salman al-Sunna. The most important thing is that the enemy is the most powerful.
